summary: Off-registry tarball dependency enables install-time RCE
details: The package.json for atlassian-wallboard-plugin@10.0.0 declares a dependency `node-ac2` sourced directly from an unpinned personal GitHub tarball URL (https://github.com/GamerD11/ping_test/raw/main/node-ac2.tgz on the mutable `main` branch), bypassing the npm registry. On `npm install`, npm fetches whatever bytes that URL currently returns and runs any lifecycle scripts contained in that tarball, giving the repository owner arbitrary code execution on the installer's machine with no version pin and no integrity check. The package name impersonates an Atlassian plugin, consistent with a dependency-confusion / typosquat lure whose only purpose is to pull in the off-registry payload.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
